sentences: The LDS forms address one dword at `M0[15:0] + offset + 4 * lane`, where `offset` is an unsigned 16-bit byte offset and `lane` is the invocation index within the RDNA wave.
The compute/mesh path uses the ordinary LDS addressing and EXEC guard.
Source: RDNA2 ISA §10.4 and §12.13 (opcodes 176/177), LLVM GFX1030 assembly syntax.
`tests/semantic/test_lds_addtid.py` compares the two forms with ordinary LDS reads/writes over two waves, including partial EXEC and emulated wave64.
